body.title: Switch createChatPanelHost to the module
body.summary: In chat-panel.ts, create one lifecycle from the resolved deps (with isOpen = !disposed and the store). runTurn keeps the echo, title and request building, and calls lifecycle.start with a TurnSink (post waiting status, governor.beginTurn, post+appendEvent+pending perms/selections+governor.observe, store.save+resolveTurn+postHistory, error post). followLiveTurn becomes lifecycle.follow with a FollowSink. Map the call sites: cancel-turn to stop; new-chat and open-chat to detach then invalidate; dispose, onDidDispose and adopt to detach; decision to live. Remove the moved state and functions, and re-export DEFAULT_TURN_LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS.
acceptanceChecks: chat-panel.test.ts and extension-chat-wiring.test.ts pass with no test edits
the full plugin suite shows no new failures against the known baseline
extension.ts is unchanged and still imports DEFAULT_TURN_LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS from chat-panel.js
runTurn calls lifecycle.start after the echo, title and save, with no await before it
createChatPanelHost no longer declares the moved turn state or functions
